# 📊 Grade to Percentage Calculator

Here's everything you need to convert grades to percentages — including the **formula**, a **standard grading scale**, and **worked examples**!

---

## 🔢 The Formula

To find the percentage, divide the scored mark by the maximum possible mark, then multiply by 100:

### ✅ Single Test:
> **Percentage = (Scored Marks ÷ Total Marks) × 100**

### ✅ Multiple Tests:
If there are multiple marks involved, first find their sum total, then divide by the maximum total marks out of which these marks were obtained, and multiply by 100 at the end to convert to percent.

> **Percentage = (Sum of Scored Marks ÷ Total Max Marks) × 100**

---

## 📝 Examples

### Example 1 — Single Test:
A student scored 85 on an exam with a maximum mark of 100.
👉 85 ÷ 100 = 0.85 × 100 = **85%**

### Example 2 — Multiple Tests:
If a student scored 92 on the first exam and 88 on the second, with a total maximum of 200:
👉 (92 + 88) ÷ 200 × 100 = **90%**

### Example 3 — Converting Percentage Score:
If you score 18/20, divide the correct answers (18) by the total questions (20) and multiply by 100:
👉 (18 ÷ 20) × 100 = **90%**

---

## 🔡 Standard US Grade-to-Percentage Scale

| Letter Grade | Percentage Range |
|---|---|
| A+ | 97 – 100% |
| A | 93 – 96% |
| A- | 90 – 92% |
| B+ | 87 – 89% |
| B | 83 – 86% |
| B- | 80 – 82% |
| C+ | 77 – 79% |
| C | 73 – 76% |
| C- | 70 – 72% |
| D+ | 67 – 69% |
| D | 63 – 66% |
| D- | 60 – 62% |
| F | Below 60% |

> This is the standard grading system for US schools and universities. However, grading may vary among schools, classes, and teachers — always check beforehand which system is used in your case.

---

## ⚖️ Weighted Grade Calculation

If your grades have different weights (e.g., homework, midterms, finals), use this formula:

**Weighted Grade = w₁×g₁ + w₂×g₂ + w₃×g₃ + ...**

### Example:
You got 67% for an essay worth 15%, 75% for a midterm worth 35%, and 72% for a final worth 50%:
👉 67% × 0.15 + 75% × 0.35 + 72% × 0.50 = 10.05 + 26.25 + 36 = **72.3% ≈ C-**

---

## 🧮 Quick Reference Table

| Score | Out of | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| 90 | 100 | 90% |
| 45 | 50 | 90% |
| 36 | 40 | 90% |
| 18 | 20 | 90% |
| 27 | 30 | 90% |

> 💡 **Tip:** Use weighted categories if your syllabus lists percentages for things like Homework, Quizzes, or Tests. Use total points if your teacher grades strictly by points earned. Matching the method your teacher uses ensures your calculated grade matches the gradebook.
